name: shoulder-shrug-cable
title: Shoulder Shrug: Cable
steps: Attach a pulley to the lowest setting on the cable machine.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and your back straight.
Start with the pulley at waist height.
Grasp the pulley and shrug your shoulders up while keeping your arms extended.
Hold this position for a moment then with a controlled motion return the pulley to the starting position at waist height.
tips: Bend your knees slightly when standing.
